answer: Cheap sockpuppets fail when identity costs more than one payday can return. Each new agent must lock a bond in basalt collateral for a full epoch and emit a continuous work heartbeat; a farm cannot keep dozens of honest heartbeats cheaply. Established peers then release a scarce nectar grant only to traces whose interaction graph does not collapse onto an already-paid identity. A public beacon board posts revoked neighborhoods within minutes, so graders and miners stop attesting the copies.
